jobs.title: Junior .NET Developer bij Olyslager
jobs.description:
Junior .NET Developer bij Olyslager

Locatie:
Bunschoten-Spakenburg
Dienstverband:
Fulltime (40 uur)
Opleidingsniveau:
HBO werk- en denkniveau (of vergelijkbaar)
Hybride werken:
Mogelijk (deels vanuit huis)

Over Olyslager

Olyslager is wereldwijd marktleider in smeermiddeldatabases voor de automotive-industrie. Onze database vormt de kern van vrijwel al onze producten — van adviessoftware tot integraties bij OEM’s en smeermiddelfabrikanten. Klanten vertrouwen op onze accurate en complete onderhouds- en smeringsinformatie om hun eindgebruikers optimaal te bedienen.
Ons team in Bunschoten-Spakenburg bestaat uit gedreven specialisten die dagelijks werken aan het verzamelen, interpreteren en ontsluiten van complexe voertuig- en applicatiedata. Bij ons krijg je de kans om jouw technische expertise in te zetten in een moderne omgeving, waar software, data en innovatie centraal staan.
We zijn onderdeel van Vitec Software Group, met een internationale lange-termijnfocus, een open cultuur en veel ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Wat de .NET Developer zal doen

Als .NET Developer maak je deel uit van het .NET development team, bestaande uit vier .NET developers en front-end developers. Samen werken jullie aan bedrijfskritische applicaties en integraties die dagelijks door klanten wereldwijd worden gebruikt.
Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt back-end functionaliteit in .NET en C#, werkt aan zowel interne als externe API’s en bent betrokken bij cloud-based dataverwerking binnen Microsoft Azure. Je werkt samen met collega’s, krijgt begeleiding waar nodig en ontwikkelt je verder in zowel technische vaardigheden als professionele werkwijze.
De functie is gericht op junior niveau (1–3 jaar ervaring), waarbij leergierigheid, motivatie en basis technisch inzicht belangrijk zijn.

De .NET Developer zal:

– Ondersteunen bij het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van back-end applicaties in .NET en C#
– Meewerken aan het bouwen en beheren van interne en externe API’s
– Onder begeleiding werken aan cloud-gebaseerde oplossingen en dataverwerking binnen Azure
– Samenwerken met front-end developers en andere teamleden
– Taken oppakken vanuit de backlog en prioriteiten, met begeleiding waar nodig
– Meedenken over technische oplossingen en verbeteringen
– Bijdragen aan stabiele en goed onderhoudbare software
– Incidenten analyseren en oplossen met ondersteuning van het team
– Deelnemen aan code reviews en leren van feedback

Dagelijks start je met een korte teamdagstart, waarna je zelfstandig of in teamverband verder werkt aan je taken en projecten.

Wie we zoeken

Je bent een startende of junior .NET Developer met een gestructureerde manier van werken en de motivatie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je voelt je prettig in een teamomgeving en staat open voor feedback en begeleiding. Je communiceert helder en wil graag leren hoe softwareontwikkeling in een professionele omgeving werkt.
Je vindt het leuk om te werken aan zowel nieuwe functionaliteit als bestaande systemen en wil bijdragen aan kwaliteit en continuïteit.

Daarnaast zal de .NET Developer:
– 1–3 jaar ervaring hebben als .NET Developer (of relevante stage/afstudeerervaring)
– Willen leren werken in een middelgroot softwarebedrijf
– Gemotiveerd zijn om ownership te ontwikkelen over taken
– Constructief meedenken en uitvoeren
– Open staan voor feedback en samenwerking

Technische vaardigheden:
– Basis kennis van moderne .NET (latest versions, geen legacy .NET Framework)
– Interesse in het ontwikkelen en beheren van API’s
– Interesse in Microsoft Azure
– Basiskennis van SQL en data-opslag
– Interesse in cloud-based data processing
– Bekendheid met Git, Azure DevOps, pipelines en pull requests is een pré
(Ervaring met Kubernetes is niet vereist)

Persoonlijke eigenschappen:
– nauwkeurig en betrouwbaar
– analytisch en probleemoplossend
– leergierig en gemotiveerd
– communicatief en samenwerkingsgericht
– proactief en nieuwsgierig

Onze tools & technische omgeving

Je werkt in een moderne Microsoft-.NET en Azure-omgeving, waarbij we gebruikmaken van de nieuwste .NET-versies en niet werken met legacy .NET Framework. Waar nodig word je ingewerkt in onze specifieke tools, processen en domeinkennis.

Wat wij bieden

De .NET Developer wordt onderdeel van een hecht, betrokken en internationaal groeiend team.
Je kunt rekenen op:
– Marktconform salaris
– 25 vakantiedagen + 5 voorwaardelijke dagen
– Hybride werken (deels vanuit huis mogelijk)
– Veel ruimte om te leren en te groeien
– Begeleiding en ondersteuning door ervaren collega’s
– Ruimte voor opleiding en ontwikkeling (o.a. jaarplan)
– Een open, collegiale werkomgeving
– Leuke teamactiviteiten en een actieve personeelsvereniging

Over Olyslager binnen Vitec

Olyslager maakt deel uit van Vitec Software Group, een toonaangevende leverancier van Vertical Software met meer dan 40 zelfstandige business units. Binnen deze internationale groep werken we met langdurige visie, bouwen we aan bedrijfskritische oplossingen en groeien we zowel organisch als door overnames.

Klaar om impact te maken met software?

De .NET Developer maakt het verschil; bij Olyslager.

Let op:
Het beheersen van de Nederlandse taal is een vereiste voor deze functie.
Beware:
Proficiency in Dutch is a requirement for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET/React)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET/React) based in Netherlands.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will build and evolve scalable, secure, and high-performing applications across both backend and frontend layers. You will work extensively with .NET and C# alongside React, Redux, and JavaScript to deliver impactful software solutions. The role combines hands-on engineering with opportunities to influence architecture, technical decisions, and development practices. You will contribute to cloud-based solutions using Google Cloud Platform and modern CI/CD practices. Working closely with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders, you will translate business needs into robust technical solutions. You will also support code quality and team development through mentoring, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, secure, reliable, and efficient full-stack applications.
Build and maintain backend services using .NET, C#, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.
Develop responsive and maintainable frontend components using React, Redux, and JavaScript.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to define and deliver new features.
Ensure applications meet high standards for performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
Write clean, efficient, well-documented code while following established engineering best practices.
Participate in code reviews, provide constructive technical feedback, and promote high standards of code quality.
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications to identify and resolve performance or reliability issues.
Contribute to software architecture discussions, technical design decisions, and long-term engineering strategy.
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous integration and deployment.
Apply cloud technologies and DevOps practices to improve development and delivery workflows.
Mentor junior engineers, share technical knowledge, and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture.
Keep up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends and identify opportunities for technical improvement.

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
At least 4 years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in .NET and C#.
Solid hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
Strong frontend development skills with React, Redux, and JavaScript.
Practical experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and cloud-based application development.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.
Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, data structures, and scalable application design.
Experience using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and software development workflows.
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical challenges.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative, and continuously evolving environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
A proactive mindset with a willingness to mentor colleagues and contribute to continuous technical improvement.

Benefits

Fully remote working model, with the opportunity to work from Latam, Europe.
Flexible working conditions designed to support a healthy work-life balance.
Opportunity to work on challenging and impactful technology projects.
Exposure to modern cloud technologies, full-stack development, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
Hands-on experience with technologies including .NET, React, GCP, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and modern engineering tooling.
Collaboration with an international, diverse, and cross-cultural team of technology professionals.
Opportunities to contribute to architectural decisions and influence technical direction.
Full-time employment with the flexibility and autonomy of a remote-first environment.
Competitive compensation and benefits package, subject to the employment arrangement and location.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). jobs.title: Software Engineer AV
jobs.description:
Word jij onze nieuwe collega?

Bij AVEX werken wij met bijna 300 collega’s vanuit 5 vestigingen in Nederland, België en de UK aan grote en kleine projecten op het gebied van audiovisuele projectinrichting en eventsupport. Wij groeien hard en zijn om deze reden op zoek naar kandidaten voor de functie van:

Software Engineer AV

Als Software Engineer AV ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het programmeren, testen en optimaliseren van audiovisuele besturingssystemen binnen complexe AV-projecten. Op basis van een functioneel en technisch ontwerp realiseer jij slimme softwareoplossingen die zorgen voor de integratie, vereenvoudiging en automatisering van audiovisuele installaties.

Je werkt voornamelijk met Windows embedded besturingssystemen en programmeert in C# binnen .NET in de omgeving van Crestron controllers. De gebruikersinterface bestaat in veel gevallen uit touchscreens en de functionaliteit varieert van relatief eenvoudig tot zeer complex. Juist de interactie tussen alle audiovisuele componenten en de centrale aansturing maakt deze functie technisch uitdagend en veelzijdig.

Je werkt nauw samen met system engineers, projectleiders en technici om hoogwaardige en stabiele oplossingen op te leveren voor onze klanten.

Wij vragen:

HBO werk- en denkniveau
Ruime ervaring met programmeren in C# binnen .NET
Goede kennis van HTML5 en eventueel ervaring met de bestaande Crestron- platformen en -omgevingen
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal
Een zelfstandige en nauwkeurige werkhouding

Wij bieden jou:

Een marktconform salaris
25 vakantiedagen
13 extra ADV dagen die je mag verruilen voor een hoger loon of gewoon lekker vrij kan nemen
Een goede pensioenregeling
Alle ruimte voor het volgen van verschillende opleidingen/trainingen
Aansluiting bij de CAO Metaal en Techniek

Over AVEX

AVEX is een vooruitstrevend familiebedrijf met hoofdkantoor in Breukelen en vestigingen in Zwolle, Brussel en London. Al meer dan 35 jaar leveren wij onze klanten innovatieve audiovisuele IT oplossingen voor projectinrichting en verzorgen het onderhoud daarvan. Maar dat niet alleen. Ook bij evenementen bieden wij alle audiovisuele eventsupport, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Vele “Top 100” bedrijven worden door onze 300 collega’s voorzien van de beste creatieve oplossingen.

jobs.title: Medior/Senior AI Software Engineer
jobs.description:
IT RBLS groeit naar een engineeringgedreven Frontier-organisatie. We bouwen steeds vaker cloud- en AI-oplossingen met Azure, Microsoft Foundry en agent-frameworks. Daarbij kiezen we bewust voor een flexibel technisch fundament, zodat we niet vastzitten aan één tool of aanpak. We onderzoeken waar AI en automatisering het ontwikkelproces kunnen versnellen, met menselijke beoordeling op de momenten die belangrijk zijn.

Om die volgende stap te zetten, zoeken we een medior of senior AI software engineer die betrouwbare klantoplossingen bouwt en meebouwt aan onze technische standaarden, werkwijze en cultuur. Of je nu al als senior opereert of als medior klaar bent voor de volgende stap: je krijgt veel ruimte voor initiatief, technische keuzes en het verder professionaliseren van onze engineeringorganisatie.

Wie zijn wij?

We fixen het. Klinkt simpel, maar het zegt veel over hoe we werken.
IT RBLS begon met de overtuiging dat IT ook anders kan. Gewoon beginnen, mouwen opstropen en bouwen. Als start-up bouwden we binnen één week onze eerste oplossing en ontdekten we hoeveel impact je kunt maken als je durft te zeggen: “We doen het gewoon.”

Technologie heeft pas waarde als mensen er echt mee vooruit kunnen. Daarom wachten we niet af. We nemen verantwoordelijkheid, zoeken oplossingen en zetten ideeën om in resultaat. Inmiddels zijn we uitgegroeid tot een vooroplopende speler binnen Microsoft Data & AI, met een gespecialiseerd Fabric-team. We helpen organisaties bij de inzet van AI, data en automatisering en challengen daarbij continu de status quo in de markt.

Je komt terecht in een team dat elkaar vertrouwt en vol zit met nieuwsgierigheid. Veel vrijheid, veel verantwoordelijkheid en vooral veel ruimte om impact te maken.

De rol

Je ontwerpt en bouwt cloud- en AI-oplossingen voor onze klanten binnen het Microsoft-ecosysteem. Je bent betrokken bij het hele traject: van het scherp krijgen van de klantvraag en het maken van technische keuzes tot implementatie, productie en beheer.
Je vertaalt klantvragen en technische eisen naar een schaalbare oplossing en kunt de gemaakte afwegingen helder toelichten. Daarbij houd je rekening met integratie in bestaande enterprise-omgevingen, beveiliging, onderhoudbaarheid en beheer.

Je werkt onder andere aan:
Cloud-native applicaties en services op Azure.
AI-applicaties, RAG-oplossingen en agentic workflows.
Integraties met bestaande systemen, databronnen en Microsoft-diensten.
Geautomatiseerde tests en CI/CD-pipelines in GitHub Actions.
Infrastructure as Code en herhaalbare deployments.
Monitoring, logging, beveiliging en beheer van oplossingen in productie.

Daarnaast bouw je mee aan ons engineeringfundament. Denk aan technische richtlijnen, herbruikbare componenten, referentiearchitecturen en een ontwikkelproces waar het hele team op kan vertrouwen. Je deelt praktijkervaring, denkt mee met collega’s en draagt bij aan code-, ontwerp- en architectuurreviews.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent niet van de standaardoplossingen. Jij snapt dat goede data-oplossingen beginnen bij 
scherpe keuzes. Je denkt vooruit, neemt eigenaarschap en weet precies wanneer je moet 
schakelen met collega’s of klanten. Conceptueel denken is je tweede natuur – net als schakelen 
tussen code en architectuur.

Je hebt minimaal vier jaar aantoonbare ervaring als software engineer. Je hebt in die periode software naar productie gebracht, verantwoordelijkheid genomen voor technische keuzes en bijgedragen aan oplossingen die ook beheerd en doorontwikkeld worden.

Je denkt vooruit, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat en weet wanneer je zelfstandig door kunt en wanneer afstemming nodig is met collega’s, klanten of andere stakeholders.

Verder herken je jezelf hierin:
Ervaring met de volledige software development lifecycle, van ontwerp en ontwikkeling tot deployment en beheer.
Sterk in minimaal één van de talen C#, Python of TypeScript.
Praktische ervaring met Azure, waarbij je zelf oplossingen hebt ontworpen, gebouwd of naar productie hebt gebracht.
Ervaring met Git, geautomatiseerd testen en CI/CD, bij voorkeur met GitHub Actions.
Gevoel voor softwarearchitectuur en voor veilige, onderhoudbare en goed testbare code.
Een ondernemende houding en het vermogen om technische afwegingen helder uit te leggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische gesprekspartners.
Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Je hoeft nog geen AI-specialist te zijn. We zoeken wel duidelijke affiniteit met AI en de ambitie om je te ontwikkelen in Azure AI Services, Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Agent Framework en MLOps toepassingen.

Heb je deze ook? Mooi meegenomen.
Ervaring met consultancy en/of projectmanagement.
Ervaring met Infrastructure as Code.
Ervaring met Power Platform en/of Fabric.
Ervaring met AI-applicaties, RAG of agentic workflows.
Je deelt graag je praktijkervaring en kunt collega’s meenemen in professioneel software ontwikkelen.

Hoe word je succesvol bij IT RBLS?

We kijken naar wat je kunt én naar wat je wilt worden. Nieuwsgierigheid, eigenaarschap en blijven leren wegen bij ons net zo zwaar als je cv. In ruil daarvoor krijg je de ruimte om te groeien en echt impact te maken.

Je maakt hier het verschil als je dit meebrengt: 
Je krijgt complexe vraagstukken snel terug tot de kern en lost ze op bij de oorzaak, niet bij het symptoom.
Je ziet het grotere plaatje, verbindt systemen en domeinen en legt trade-offs uit in gewone taal.
Je maakt af wat je start: je stuurt oplossingen naar de streep en krijgt stakeholders mee.
Je bent zelfstandig en proactief, en voelt je thuis in een agile team zonder dat iemand achter je aan hoeft.
Je deelt kennis en tilt collega’s op, want daar wordt het hele team beter van.
Je denkt in waarde voor de klant, niet in gewerkte uren.

Als medior krijg je de ruimte om te groeien in technisch eigenaarschap, architectuur en klantadvies. Als senior verwachten we dat je hierin vanaf het begin richting geeft en ook collega’s helpt groeien.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij IT RBLS krijg je niet alleen een project, je krijgt vertrouwen. En verantwoordelijkheid. Je werkt met een team dat net zo scherp en nieuwsgierig is als jij. Je krijgt de vrijheid om je rol op jouw manier in te vullen. Met impact als maatstaf, niet een 9-tot-5 schema. We investeren in je ontwikkeling, laten je groeien tot expert in Fabric en breder. En omdat we weten wat we van je vragen, krijg je er ook wat voor terug: een leaseauto die je zelf kiest, een sportbudget voor je energie, maandelijkse teamuitjes voor de fun en een salaris dat gewoon klopt, boven marktconform. Omdat jij het verschil maakt.

Interesse?

Heb jij de drive en ervaring die we zoeken? Neem dan contact op met Arthur Janssen via a.janssen@itrbls.com. Dan plannen we snel een kop koffie in. Als we na de eerste kennismaking beide nog een vervolg willen plannen we een tweede gesprek in voor verdere kennismaking met het team (vooral even mee lunchen!) en het doornemen van de arbeidsvoorwaarden. Iedereen happy? Dan bestellen we snel je nieuwe laptop en leaseauto!

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Voor een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is en werkt aan maatschappelijk relevante digitale oplossingen, zijn wij op zoek naar een Software Architect. Je komt terecht in een professionele IT-omgeving waar softwareontwikkeling, cloudtechnologie en architectuur samenkomen.

Als Software Architect speel je een belangrijke rol bij het vertalen van strategische architectuurprincipes naar concrete technische oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met Enterprise Architects, developers en verschillende stakeholders en zorgt ervoor dat nieuwe en bestaande oplossingen aansluiten bij de technische en organisatorische doelstellingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Software Architect ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en verder ontwikkelen van toekomstbestendige softwareoplossingen. Je werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:
Vertalen van de doelarchitectuur naar concrete oplossingen die door developmentteams gerealiseerd kunnen worden.
Ontwerpen van oplossingsrichtingen in samenwerking met Enterprise Architects en ontwikkelteams.
Ontwerpen van softwarearchitecturen voor nieuwe producten en digitale diensten.
Opstellen van transitieplannen voor het moderniseren van bestaande oplossingen en applicaties.
Definiëren van non-functional requirements, zoals security, performance, schaalbaarheid en beschikbaarheid.
Onderzoeken van nieuwe technologieën en beoordelen hoe deze binnen de organisatie kunnen worden toegepast.
Meewerken aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een modern softwarelandschap, bestaande uit zowel on-premise technologie als cloud- en SaaS-oplossingen.
Werken met Microsoft-technologie en Azure binnen een breed en voortdurend veranderend IT-landschap.
Fungeren als technisch sparringpartner voor developers en andere IT-professionals.
Coachen van ontwikkelaars en bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van softwarearchitectuur binnen de organisatie.

Je krijgt hierbij veel ruimte om inhoudelijk mee te denken en invloed uit te oefenen op de technische richting van de organisatie.

Wat bieden wij?

Je komt terecht in een professionele en collegiale werkomgeving waarin kennisdeling, ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief worden gestimuleerd. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:
Een salaris tot circa €5.800 bruto per maand o.b.v. 36-urige werkweek, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.
Een aantrekkelijk individueel keuzebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld extra verlof, opleiding of extra inkomen.
Een eindejaarsuitkering.
Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.
Volledige vergoeding van openbaar vervoer en een aantrekkelijke kilometervergoeding.
Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen, trainingen en professionele ontwikkeling.
Een laptop en smartphone of een passende telefoonvergoeding.
Een veelzijdige functie met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op de verdere ontwikkeling van het IT-landschap.

Wat breng je mee?

Voor deze functie zoeken we een ervaren Software Architect die zowel technisch sterk is als gemakkelijk schakelt met verschillende stakeholders.
Je beschikt over:
Een hbo-diploma in de richting van Informatica, Bedrijfskundige Informatica of een vergelijkbare opleiding.
Ruime ervaring binnen een Microsoft-georiënteerde IT-omgeving.
Ervaring als Software Architect en bij voorkeur ook een achtergrond als software developer.
Uitgebreide kennis van Microsoft Azure, Visual Studio en Azure DevOps.
Ervaring met Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) en het ontwerpen van complexe softwareoplossingen.
Ervaring met het opstellen van architectuurprincipes, technische ontwerpen en transitieplannen.
Een proactieve en resultaatgerichte werkhouding.
Het vermogen om als senior gesprekspartner complexe technische vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende stakeholders.
Sterke communicatieve en analytische vaardigheden.
Organisatiesensitiviteit en het vermogen om effectief om te gaan met verschillende belangen en veranderende omstandigheden.

Interesse?

Ben jij een ervaren Software Architect en wil je werken aan complexe vraagstukken binnen een organisatie waar technologie een belangrijke maatschappelijke rol speelt? Dan komen we graag met je in contact.

Senior Mendix Platform Engineer

Are you an experienced Mendix developer who brings additional expertise in DevOps, testing, frontend styling or high code? Do you enjoy solving technical challenges that extend across applications and teams?
For an international organisation, I'm recruiting a Senior Mendix Platform Engineer based in the Netherlands. English-speaking professionals are welcome, and IND sponsorship is available through us.
Your role
You will build and improve a platform supporting more than 68 Mendix applications. Your work enables development teams to deliver reliable applications through reusable modules, integrations, automation and shared platform services.
Working closely with application teams, you will investigate complex issues, improve platform standards and make development and deployment processes more efficient.

What makes this role challenging?
The complexity lies in building solutions that work across an entire Mendix landscape. A change to a shared module, deployment pipeline or design system can affect many applications and teams. You need to understand those dependencies, investigate downstream impact and deliver solutions that remain maintainable at scale.
Years of Mendix development experience alone are therefore not enough. We're looking for someone who combines strong hands-on Mendix skills with broader platform experience and an additional area of expertise. This could be DevOps, styling, testing, high code or the ability to bridge complex technical discussions between teams. High-code experience without practical Mendix experience does not meet the requirements of this role.
What will you do?
Build and maintain reusable Mendix modules, components, integrations and platform services.
Automate deployment processes and help applications adopt updated platform modules with minimal manual effort.
Develop and improve pipelines and automation within Azure DevOps and the wider enterprise infrastructure.
Investigate complex issues across shared components, consuming applications and connected systems.
Collaborate with development teams to resolve design system issues and understand their impact across applications.
Use Mendix and adjacent technologies to reduce duplication and support secure, high-quality delivery.
Document technical decisions, present solutions and improve platform standards and developer experience.

What do you bring?
Strong hands-on Mendix development experience and the ability to explain your technical decisions.
Experience building or maintaining shared solutions used by multiple applications or development teams.
Additional expertise that strengthens the team, such as DevOps, frontend styling, testing, high code or technical communication.
An understanding of integrations, dependencies and the impact of platform changes on consuming applications.
Experience with CI/CD, deployment automation or Azure DevOps is particularly relevant.
Clear communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
Persistence and ownership when solving complex problems across teams and systems.
You currently live in the Netherlands.
Practical information
An international working environment where English-speaking professionals are welcome.
36 hours per week, with the option to work 40 hours.
IND sponsorship available through us.

Flexible working hours within a Gleitzeit model, supporting a healthy work-life balance, with options for remote work and home office arrangements.
Modern, centrally located office spaces in Innsbruck, directly opposite the Olympiaworld, providing a comfortable and inspiring work environment.
Competitive salary starting from EUR 4,000 gross monthly based on 14 salaries, with potential for higher compensation based on experience and expertise.

Equal Opportunity

RiskConsult GmbH is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. On-site | Full-Time | Karlsruhe, Germany

5 Million Players. 4.8 Stars.

We're just getting started.

Iteration One is a self-funded, independent gaming studio in Karlsruhe. With Nightclub Tycoon - a free-to-play idle tycoon game on iOS and Android - we've built a game played by millions, with a small team and no outside money.

We're 7 people. We're growing. And we're looking for a software engineer who's excited about where the craft is heading - where AI handles the repetitive typing and boilerplate, and you focus on the thinking, the architecture, and the decisions that actually matter.

Tasks

What You'll Do

You'll work across the full development cycle - from pre-production through live operations - as part of a small, cross-functional team. That means writing and optimizing C# in Unity, building efficient and reusable systems, and making sure your code is something your teammates can actually work with. You'll use tools like Codex or Claude Code daily as a core part of how you work. You'll contribute to coding standards, design documents, and help the team move faster and smarter.

No ticket queues. No waiting for permission. You'll have real influence over what we build and how we build it.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Depending on the level, strong professional background in C# and Unity, ideally with live game experience

Ability to write clean, understandable code and document it properly

Collaborative - comfortable working across design, production, and art

Able to estimate timelines and deliver on them

Understanding of mobile development for Android and iOS

Passion for technology and AI

Nice to have: deep knowledge of Unity pipelines (asset management, UI, networking), experience with reactive programming (UniRx), and a track record of resolving memory and performance issues.

On AI

We're going all-in on AI - and we mean that seriously. Not as a productivity tip or a trend to follow, but as the operating system of how this company works. We believe the companies that figure this out are the future, and we intend to be one of them. We expect you to use tools like Codex, Claude Code and other as part of your daily workflow - not occasionally, but as a default. If you see AI as an opportunity rather than a threat and you're already experimenting - you'll feel at home here.

Benefits

How You'll Grow

Growth here is on you, but the conditions are real. We're building a company where people grow into the entrepreneurs of tomorrow. Through real ownership, transparency, space to experiment, and permission to take risks.

You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, run experiments, and own your work end to end. What you ship reaches millions of devices, and we want you to feel that weight and be motivated by it. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to be, we'd love to hear from you.

The Basics

Location: Karlsruhe, Germany (close to main station)

Work model: Work 1 day remotely and 4 days on-site

Employment: Full-time

Working language: English / German

We keep it simple and move fast - because your time matters too. A first interview to get to know each other, a second to go deeper, and a short trial task to see how you work. No endless rounds, no committees.

If it feels like a fit on both sides, you'll know quickly.

Ready to build something great? We'd love to hear from you.

is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.  
Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)
Language requirement:
fluency in German or Spanish
Location:
Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA
Employment:
18-month FTC with view to extend

About the role:

We’re hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.
 Key Responsibilities:New Business and Client Engagement Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.
Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

 About You:Essential 10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.
Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

 What Success Looks Like: Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

Produktentwicklung & Architektur
Du entwickelst und gestaltest Features für unsere Projekte von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
Du triffst fundierte Architekturentscheidungen und bringst dich aktiv in die technische Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte ein.

Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und strukturiert und weißt, wann du Entscheidungen selbst triffst und wann du das Team einbindest.

jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.
The Import Export organization builds and scales infrastructure for secure, reliable, high-throughput data movement across RelativityOne.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products.
You will collaborate with a senior engineering team and business stakeholders to build features and services that evolve RelativityOne SaaS.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Design architecture and non-functional aspects of Import/Export services aligned with SLO/SLA targets
Break down complex problems into resilient, cloud-native designs and deliver measurable outcomes
Mentor team members on code quality, best practices, and technical debt management
Own production systems, including on-call responsibilities, root cause analysis, and proactive issue resolution
Drive operational excellence through observability, alerting automation, and reliable metrics
Collaborate with Product to shape roadmap decisions using data and clear trade-offs
Improve CI/CD processes through automation and predictable, compliant deployments

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of experience building C#/.NET or similar services with demonstrated reliability or performance improvements
Experience designing distributed SaaS systems and translating business needs into technical solutions
Production ownership experience, including on-call rotations, incident response, and reducing MTTR using telemetry
Experience delivering cloud-native systems (Azure or similar platforms)
Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation, testing, and deployment governance
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
English proficiency for technical communication

Preferred

Experience leading microservices development for high-volume, event-driven systems
Experience scaling ingestion pipelines, ETL workflows, or data processing systems with measurable outcomes
Experience mentoring teams in agile planning and cross-team collaboration

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title

Application Security Engineer

Summary

TRD Professional Services is looking for an Application Security Engineer (development-focused white hat) to identify and reduce risk across our applications and support the secure development of new customer projects. The role works closely with development and QA teams to embed security into the full software lifecycle, covering threat modelling, secure coding, vulnerability management and PCI compliance.

This position sits at the intersection of security, development and QA, making sure security is built in from the start rather than added later.

Key Responsibilities

Review new application designs with architecture and development teams to identify security risks early and flag potential blockers before implementation begins
Lead threat modelling sessions with dev, QA and business teams to identify risks early in solution design
Review code and binary scan results, working with developers to fix vulnerabilities during development
Assess and manage existing vulnerabilities using CVSS, define remediation actions and track progress
Support PCI-DSS compliance by collecting audit evidence with dev, QA and platform teams
Work with QA to ensure adequate security test coverage across functional and non-functional testing

About The Ideal Candidate

Relevant experience in software development (.NET), application security, or infrastructure security (AWS/Azure);

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (Agentic AI Platform)
jobs.description:
What You Will Do

We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to play a key role in building our Agentic AI Platform a system of autonomous, tool-using AI agents that plan, reason, and execute complex business workflows end-to-end. The ideal candidate combines strong ML fundamentals with hands-on experience in LLM-based application development, agent orchestration frameworks, and Microsoft Azure cloud services. You will architect and ship production-grade agentic solutions, mentor junior team members, and set technical direction for GenAI initiatives across the organization.

How You Will Do It

Design, build, and productionize multi-agent systems, including planning, tool calling / function calling, memory, and orchestration, using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel.
Develop RAG pipelines end-to-end: document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search (Azure AI Search / FAISS / pgvector), re-ranking, and grounding for agent knowledge.
Integrate agents with enterprise systems and APIs via tool/function calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar connector patterns.
Build and maintain LLM evaluation frameworks for agentic workflows, task-completion metrics, hallucination detection, trajectory analysis, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and A/B testing.
Implement guardrails, safety, and governance for agents: prompt-injection defense, content filtering, role-based tool permissions, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and audit logging.
Fine-tune and optimize LLMs where needed (LoRA/PEFT, prompt optimization, model routing, latency/cost trade-offs) on Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry.
Design, build, and evaluate classical ML models (classification, regression, forecasting, NLP) where they complement agentic workflows.
Own LLMOps/MLOps for the platform: experiment tracking, prompt versioning, CI/CD, observability and tracing (LangSmith, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry), drift monitoring, and retraining strategies.
Collaborate with data engineers on data quality, availability, and governance across Azure Data Lake, Databricks, and Synapse Analytics.
Translate ambiguous business problems into agentic AI solutions; present architecture decisions and results to senior stakeholders.
Mentor junior data scientists, lead code/design reviews, and champion engineering best practices.

Required

professional experience in data science / ML, with building LLM or GenAI applications in production.
Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks LangChain or LangGraph.
Strong understanding of LLM application patterns including prompt engineering
Expert-level Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, async programming, API development with FastAPI).
Experience with vector databases and embeddings (Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS, or pgvector).
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale data.

Preferred

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with Azure services: Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, Azure ML, Azure AI Search, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or Synapse.
Solid grounding in classical ML: supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and hyperparameter tuning; experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), OpenAI Assistants/Agents SDK, or Anthropic tool-use APIs.
Strong understanding of function/tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, agent memory, and multi-agent orchestration.
Proven MLOps/LLMOps experience: MLflow, prompt/model versioning, CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), and production monitoring.
Ability to evaluate and mitigate LLM-specific risks: hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, and cost/latency constraints.
Experience with AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel.
Microsoft certifications: AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer), DP-100 (Azure Data Scientist Associate).
Experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Phi) using LoRA/QLoRA and serving via vLLM or Azure ML endpoints.
Familiarity with observability/tracing for agents: LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or OpenTelemetry.
Knowledge of containerization and deployment: Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Azure Container Apps.
Big data experience with Apache Spark (PySpark) via Azure Databricks.
Experience with knowledge graphs, graph RAG, or semantic layers for agent grounding.
Contributions to open-source GenAI/agentic projects or published technical content.

Our Salary And Benefits

The initial basic salary for this position will be in the range of 13,591 PLN – 21,233 PLN per month. The final package will reflect your experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role. We are committed to fair, equitable, and gender-neutral pay practices.

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.
The Import Export organization builds and scales infrastructure for secure, reliable, high-throughput data movement across RelativityOne.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products.
You will collaborate with a senior engineering team and business stakeholders to build features and services that evolve RelativityOne SaaS.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Design architecture and non-functional aspects of Import/Export services aligned with SLO/SLA targets
Break down complex problems into resilient, cloud-native designs and deliver measurable outcomes
Mentor team members on code quality, best practices, and technical debt management
Own production systems, including on-call responsibilities, root cause analysis, and proactive issue resolution
Drive operational excellence through observability, alerting automation, and reliable metrics
Collaborate with Product to shape roadmap decisions using data and clear trade-offs
Improve CI/CD processes through automation and predictable, compliant deployments

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of experience building C#/.NET or similar services with demonstrated reliability or performance improvements
Experience designing distributed SaaS systems and translating business needs into technical solutions
Production ownership experience, including on-call rotations, incident response, and reducing MTTR using telemetry
Experience delivering cloud-native systems (Azure or similar platforms)
Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation, testing, and deployment governance
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
English proficiency for technical communication

Preferred

Experience leading microservices development for high-volume, event-driven systems
Experience scaling ingestion pipelines, ETL workflows, or data processing systems with measurable outcomes
Experience mentoring teams in agile planning and cross-team collaboration

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm or Tallinn – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

You will join one of our product teams and on a daily basis:

Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and other workflows
Initiate, participate in, and communicate technical architecture designs
Attend regular scrum ceremonies as a member of an agile cross-functional team
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Qualifications

What you bring:

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs
Years of experience using relational databases, preferably SQL Server. Additionally, working knowledge of ORMs, preferably Entity Framework
Familiarity with cloud development; experience with Azure is a bonus
Practical knowledge of using messaging platforms in a distributed architecture (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka)
Knowledge and experience on a FinTech and banking industry is a plus
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and sound judgement about reviewing and testing what they produce, is a plus
Fluent English

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Germany.

Hyvinvoivat työntekijät ja sujuvan arjen luominen ovat Goforen ydin. Haluamme olla työyhteisö, jossa työn tekeminen on innostavaa, palkitsevaa ja ammatillista osaamista kasvattavaa. Asiakkaitamme ovat muun muassa Metso , Aimo Park , TE-Digi ja Digi- ja Väestötietovirasto . Rakennamme yhdessä digitaalisia palveluita, joilla on todellista yhteiskunnallista merkitystä.

Turvalliseen ohjelmistokehitykseen erikoistuneena ohjelmistokehittäjänä varmistat, että tiimin tuottamat ratkaisut täyttävät vaativat tietoturvavaatimukset ja että tietoturva huomioidaan luontevasti projektin kaikissa vaiheissa.

Painopisteenäsi on puolustavaan tietoturvaan liittyvien ohjelmistoratkaisuiden kehittäminen, mutta teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myös hyökkäävän tietoturvan asiantuntijoiden sekä laadunvarmistuksen kanssa.

Projektityön ohella osallistut tietoturvallisen ohjelmistokehityksen menetelmien kehittämiseen koko Goforen laajuisesti ja toimit tarvittaessa oman erikoisosaamisalueesi tukena myös muissa projekteissa.

.

jobs.title: Praktikant til full stack-udvikling og digitale forretningsprocesser
jobs.location: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
jobs.description:
Er du studerende med interesse for full stack-udvikling og digitale forretningsprocesser?

Vi søger en engageret praktikant, der kan binde vores digitale løsninger sammen med de daglige processer. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med de kolleger, der bruger systemerne.
Du indsamler deres behov og omsætter dem til løsninger, fra brugerfladen og helt ned i data og integrationer. Opgaverne er reelle, og de løsninger, du er med til at udvikle, bliver taget i brug i virksomheden.
I efteråret 2025 implementerede vi Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central i en tekstiltilpasset løsning. Siden har vi udviklet vores egne applikationer oven på ERP-systemet, og de understøtter i dag en stor del af de daglige arbejdsgange. Med fundamentet på plads er vi nu klar til en række optimeringsprojekter, hvor du kommer til at spille en aktiv rolle.

Opgaverne vil bl.a. omfatte:

udvikling af nye applikationer og videreudvikling af vores interne portal.
udvikling af integrationer og rapportering baseret på data fra ERP-systemet.
samarbejde med brugerne, så systemet og de værktøjer, vi udvikler, bliver brugt bedst muligt.
dokumentation og procesforbedringer.

Vi er i gang med at udvikle en kommunikationsplatform til vores leverandører og vi vil på længere sigt udvikle en til kunderne. Her får du indflydelse på både arkitekturen, arbejdsgange og den endelige løsning.

DET TEKNISKE:

Vores løsninger bygger på en Microsoft-baseret platform. Kernen er udviklet i .NET og vores webapplikation bygget i React.
Data fra Business Central synkroniseres løbende til vores egen SQL-database. Via API'er integrerer vi med eksterne partnere, fx fragtfirmaer, og det samme fundament bruges til overblik og rapportering.
Al vores kode ligger på GitHub. Vi arbejder aktivt med Github og al test og udrulning er automatiseret. AI er en integreret del af vores udviklingsproces. Vi bruger AI-værktøjer aktivt til kodning, review og problemløsning, og du lærer at bruge dem effektivt og ansvarligt. Du behøver ikke kende alle værktøjerne på forhånd. Du får erfaring med hele forløbet fra idé og analyse til en løsning i drift.

OM OS:

Vi er et lille, dedikeret team, der hjælper outdoor-brands med at udvikle og producere specialtilpasset beklædning – især inden for jagt. Vores styrke ligger i nørderiet: vi elsker at fordybe os i materialer, funktioner og detaljer, der gør forskellen ude i naturen.
I virksomheden har vi gode IT-kompetencer i form af en fuldtidsansat IT-arkitekt og en studiemedhjælper som begge kender virksomheden og selv har været i praktik ved CD Company. Så der er rum for både forretningsmæssig- og fagligudvikling i praktikken.
Hos os møder du en uformel atmosfære, hvor der altid er kaffe på kanden og snacks i skålene. Vi tror på, at de gode løsninger vokser frem i fællesskab, gennem åben diskussion og masser af energi.

OM DIG:

er i gang med en relevant IT-uddannelse, fx softwareudvikling, datamatiker, IT-arkitektur eller lign.
har kendskab til programmering og interesse for full stack-udvikling, API'er og integrationer.
er interesseret i ERP-systemer og i, hvordan IT kan understøtte og forbedre forretningens processer.
er nysgerrig på AI og moderne udviklingsværktøjer og har lyst til at bruge dem i praksis.
trives med at arbejde tæt på brugerne og kan omsætte deres behov til tekniske løsninger.
tager ansvar for dine opgaver og kan både arbejde selvstændigt og i et lille team.

jobs.description:
Project description

Join our Development Center in Bucharest, and become a member of our open-minded, progressive and professional team. In this role you will be working on projects for one our world famous clients.
You will have a chance to grow your technical and soft skills, and build a thorough expertise of the industry of our client.
On top of attractive salary and benefits package, Luxoft will invest into your professional training, and allow you to grow your professional career.

Responsibilities

Backend Automation (High Priority): Design, develop, and maintain robust API test automation frameworks, ensuring comprehensive coverage of data flows and integration points within the Atlas module.
Frontend Automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests for web user interfaces to ensure a seamless and reliable user experience.
Manual Testing: Design and execute manual tests for APIs, integrations, data flows, and web interfaces, including exploratory, functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Test Planning & Documentation: Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and test scripts aligned with requirements, user stories, and technical specifications.
Team Collaboration & Agile Delivery: Collaborate with Product Owners, developers, system architects, and compliance specialists to clarify requirements and regulatory constraints. Participate in Agile ceremonies, provide timely feedback, and promote quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Leverage AI Tools: Use modern AI-assisted coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test script development, improve code quality, and streamline the QA pipeline.
Defect Management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution. Analyze results from both manual and automated test execution, support root-cause analysis, retest fixes, and perform targeted regression testing.
Release Readiness & Compliance: Contribute to the SDLC release process by preparing, reviewing, or approving Test Execution Reports (TERs) for production deployments and ensuring test evidence supports applicable AML, GDPR, and local regulatory requirements.
Leadership & Continuous Improvement: Provide technical guidance, promote quality engineering best practices, review and improve test processes and methodologies, and recommend enhancements to manual and automated testing. Keep current with new testing tools, techniques, and technologies to improve quality and delivery efficiency.

Skills

Must have

Professional Experience: 5+ years of hands-on software testing experience, including substantial experience in both manual testing and test automation across backend systems, integrations, web user interfaces, and data-centric applications.
Manual Testing Expertise: Proven ability to analyse requirements, design and execute detailed manual test cases and test scripts, perform exploratory and risk-based testing, validate API responses, integrations, data flows, and web user interfaces, and maintain clear test evidence and traceability.
Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in either Python or Java. As AI-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Copilot are integrated into the daily workflow, logical thinking, clean test design, maintainable code, and architectural best practices are valued over syntax memorization.
Backend & API Testing (High Priority): Proven experience automating REST and/or SOAP API tests with tools such as REST Assured, Requests, PyTest, or Postman. Strong understanding of integration testing, data integrity, source-to-target validation, microservices architecture, and SQL and NoSQL database concepts.
Frontend Testing: Solid experience in web UI test automation using modern frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress, together with a good understanding of the DOM structure, XPath, and CSS selectors.
CI/CD & Version Control: Practical experience with Git and a working understanding of integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions, including analysis of automated test-run results.
Methodologies & Test Engineering: Experience working in Agile environments using Scrum or Kanban, Jira, and Confluence. Strong knowledge of the software development lifecycle, test planning, defect management, test execution reporting, and functional and non-functional testing practices.

Nice to have

Experience in the financial services industry, with knowledge of Wealth Management or other financial products.
Experience in coordinating UAT (User Acceptance Testing) activities.
Openness and willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.

jobs.title: Azure Backend Engineer – Cloud Native & AI-Assisted Development
jobs.description:
🚀
¿Te unes al reto?

En BIP – xTech estamos buscando a gente con ganas de crecer, aprender y enfrentarse a proyectos tecnológicos de verdad: cloud, datos, IA, seguridad, automatización, DevSecOps, IoT, Industria 4.0… ¡Aquí no te vas a aburrir!

Somos un equipo diverso y con muchas ganas, donde combinamos tecnología con estrategia para ofrecer soluciones top a nuestros clientes. Si te interesa estar en el centro de la transformación digital y construir soluciones cloud modernas sobre Azure, este es tu sitio.

💼
¿Qué harás?

La forma de desarrollar software está cambiando. Herramientas como GitHub Copilot, Claude Code y otros asistentes de IA permiten acelerar enormemente el desarrollo, pero seguimos necesitando buenos ingenieros capaces de diseñar la solución, tomar decisiones técnicas, integrar sistemas y garantizar que el código generado sea mantenible, seguro y esté preparado para producción.

Ahí entras tú.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia sólida en desarrollo backend con .NET y Azure, acostumbrada a construir APIs, microservicios e integraciones cloud-native.

Trabajarás en soluciones donde Azure es una parte fundamental de la arquitectura, utilizando servicios como AKS, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault o Application Insights, entre otros.

Y queremos que la IA forme parte de tu forma habitual de desarrollar: desde generar y refactorizar código hasta crear tests, documentación, revisar implementaciones o acelerar la resolución de problemas.

✅
Lo que necesitamos de ti

Imprescindible tener al menos 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend con .NET, con especial foco en:

· Desarrollo .NET / C#: experiencia sólida con .NET moderno, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, Dependency Injection, configuración, logging y gestión de errores.

· Diseño y desarrollo de APIs REST, incluyendo definición de contratos, versionado, autenticación/autorización, validación y documentación con OpenAPI/Swagger.

· Arquitecturas de microservicios: diseño de servicios desacoplados, comunicación síncrona y asíncrona, resiliencia, observabilidad y gestión de errores.

· Azure Functions: desarrollo de funciones HTTP, event-driven y background processing, incluyendo triggers y bindings.

· Integración en Azure: experiencia trabajando con servicios como Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid y Storage Queues/Blob Storage para construir arquitecturas orientadas a eventos e integración entre sistemas.

· Azure Key Vault y gestión segura de secretos, certificados y configuración sensible.

· Conocimiento de Managed Identities, Entra ID y OAuth2/OIDC para autenticación entre aplicaciones y servicios Azure.

· Experiencia trabajando con SQL Server / Azure SQL y acceso a datos desde .NET, idealmente utilizando Entity Framework Core.

· Conocimientos de Docker y containerización de aplicaciones .NET.

· Experiencia trabajando con Git y procesos de CI/CD, entendiendo cómo una aplicación pasa desde el código hasta los diferentes entornos.

· Experiencia real utilizando asistentes de desarrollo basados en IA, como GitHub Copilot, Claude Code o herramientas similares, no sólo para autocompletar código, sino como parte habitual del ciclo de desarrollo.

Esperamos que seas capaz de utilizar IA para generar, revisar, refactorizar, documentar y testear código, manteniendo siempre criterio técnico sobre lo que genera.

🔍
Nos suma mucho si además:

· Has trabajado con arquitecturas event-driven y patrones como Pub/Sub, queues, topics o asynchronous processing.

· Experiencia desplegando o desarrollando aplicaciones que se ejecutan sobre Kubernetes, trabajando con containers, configuración, secrets, health checks, scaling y troubleshooting básico.

· Conoces patrones de diseño de microservicios como API Gateway, Circuit Breaker, Retry, Outbox, Saga o CQRS.

· Tienes experiencia con Azure Container Apps además de AKS.

· Has trabajado con Application Insights, Azure Monitor y Log Analytics para observabilidad y troubleshooting.

· Conocimientos de Azure API Management (APIM): publicación y consumo de APIs, policies, seguridad, versionado y gestión del ciclo de vida de las APIs.

· Conoces Redis / Azure Managed Redis y estrategias de caching.

· Has trabajado con Cosmos DB u otras bases de datos NoSQL.

· Entiendes conceptos de Infrastructure as Code, especialmente Terraform, aunque no esperamos que seas especialista.

· Has trabajado con Azure DevOps o GitHub Actions para CI/CD.

· Tienes experiencia escribiendo tests unitarios, de integración y contract tests.

· Has utilizado herramientas como SonarQube, GitHub Advanced Security, Snyk o similares para mejorar la calidad y seguridad del código.

· Has trabajado con Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry, Semantic Kernel o integración de modelos de IA dentro de aplicaciones.

· Has trabajado con MCP, agentes de desarrollo, skills, instrucciones de repositorio o workflows agentic para mejorar el contexto que reciben las herramientas de IA durante el desarrollo.

· Tienes formación técnica (Informática, Telecomunicaciones, etc.).

· Te manejas bien en inglés.

· Tienes alguna certificación oficial de Microsoft Azure.

🧠
¿Qué valoramos?

· Mentalidad de ingeniería: no buscamos únicamente a alguien que programe historias de usuario, sino que entienda cómo encaja su código dentro de la arquitectura completa.

· Capacidad para diseñar soluciones simples, mantenibles y preparadas para producción.

· Criterio para decidir cuándo utilizar un microservicio, una Function, una Logic App o cualquier otro servicio de Azure.

· Entender que la IA acelera el desarrollo, pero no sustituye el criterio técnico.

· Capacidad para revisar críticamente el código generado por herramientas de IA y detectar problemas de arquitectura, seguridad, rendimiento o mantenibilidad.

· Mentalidad API-first y cloud-native.

· Buenas prácticas de desarrollo: clean code, testing, observabilidad y seguridad desde el diseño.

· Ganas de aportar, trabajar en equipo y seguir aprendiendo.

· Responsabilidad con tu trabajo y compromiso con el equipo.

· Curiosidad por cómo la IA generativa y los agentes están transformando el ciclo de desarrollo de software.

🌟
¿Por qué unirte a BIP?

· Personas primero: valoramos tu talento y tu equilibrio personal.

· Entorno ágil y flexible: trabajamos en remoto y con horarios que se adaptan a ti.

· Formación cont
inua: tendrás acceso a cursos top en tecnología e innovación.

· Proyectos con impacto: trabajarás con empresas líderes construyendo plataformas, APIs, microservicios e integraciones sobre Azure.

· Desarrollo aumentado por IA: queremos que herramientas como GitHub Copilot o Claude Code formen parte de tu día a día y que nos ayudes a evolucionar nuestra forma de desarrollar software.

· Un equipo que suma: buen ambiente, colaboración real y cero postureo.

📩
¿Y ahora qué?

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer, R&D
jobs.description:
Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or Casablanca.

Unique problems to solve: a good fix in the morning can be live in production by the evening, and it will be serving real partner traffic.

Nuitée is hiring Senior Product Engineers to join Connect, the domain at the heart of our platform. Connect is where hotel supply from hundreds of suppliers becomes one clean API that partners build on: how we connect to suppliers, price and serve inventory at scale, and make fragmented travel data usable in real time.

You'll work across the full lifecycle, building new capabilities and scaling the systems partners rely on every day. You'll go from idea to production without detailed specs, and you'll be accountable for whether what you ship creates real value.

The problem is hard: latency, correctness, cost and supplier limits all pull in different directions, and the product decisions can't be separated from the technical ones.

What makes it interesting for you:

You can move extremely fast. There's very little red tape and teams make their own product decisions. A good idea in the morning can be in production by the evening, and many iterations ship in days rather than months.
You own the path to the outcome. You'll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there, including when to say no.
You get genuinely hard engineering problems. Caching, multi-supplier pricing, data pipelines, and routing under strict latency budgets all interact in real time.
You'll shape how we build. We got to roughly €1B in booking value with a lean team. Now we're building the next phase of the platform as we push toward €10B, and you'll help set the engineering and product standards.

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre.

The kind of problems you’ll work on:

How do we take fragmented, inconsistent data from hundreds of suppliers and serve it reliably through a clean API?
How do we cache and deliver a pricing matrix covering 100k+ hotels so partners can use it in real time?
How do we answer multi-supplier rate requests within strict latency budgets, route to the best suppliers, and protect supplier QPS and system stability under load?
How do we harmonize data across suppliers (room mapping, for example), including with LLM-assisted approaches?

You’ll work on problems where the product, technical approach, and best path forward are still being figured out.
The role is backend-heavy and product-driven. You should be comfortable going from idea to design, implementation, and real usage, without needing detailed specs.
A good way to think of it is: you build the first version that proves something works.

This role fits someone who:

Is a senior and hands-on backend engineer, ideally with experience in Go (but we’re also interested in people from C#, Java, C++ or similar backgrounds who want to pick up Go).
Has built products or major features from scratch.
Thinks in terms of outcomes and user value, not just implementation.
Is comfortable working without clear specs or structure.
Can make pragmatic tradeoffs and move fast.
Has experience with APIs, data-heavy systems, or distributed environments.
Takes ownership beyond their scope and pushes things forward.

Nuitée is fast-moving, low on process, and high on ownership. This suits people who are comfortable with ambiguity, pace, and responsibility. It is less suited to people who prefer structured environments and clearly defined scope from day one.

If that resonates, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2 to 3 weeks

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your Mission

We're looking for a Frontend QA Engineering Intern to support our mission of delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing automated solutions. In this role, you’ll work alongside experienced QA engineers and developers to test new features, identify issues, and ensure the best possible user experience from the UI level.

Your focus will be on frontend testing across key example projects, such as operational workflows, AI integrations, and low-code automation tools. Leveraging modern low-code platforms like Appian and UiPath, your curiosity, attention to detail, and understanding of software quality principles will be key in maintaining Bitpanda’s standards of excellence, innovation, and operational scalability.

Execute Frontend Testing:

Support QA in ensuring product quality, reliability, and performance through structured frontend testing, validating end-to-end user journeys, AI integrations, and automated business processes.
