Design, execute, and maintain frontend test cases using low-code automation tools such as Appian and UiPath, ensuring complete alignment with product and business objectives.
Monitor & Track Bugs:

Assist in monitoring, reporting, and tracking defects using standard QA tools and workflows (Jira), contributing clear visual proofs and step-by-step reproduction details for efficient issue resolution.
Drive Quality in Agile Sprints:

Participate actively in sprint planning and review meetings, sharing insights to enhance frontend test coverage and drive a culture of quality across teams.

Who You Are
Frontend & Quality Mindset:

Detail-oriented and proactive, with a keen interest in user experience, UI workflows, and ensuring the overall reliability of software products.
Low-Code & Automation Curious:

Familiar with core testing concepts (manual testing, test automation, agile methodologies) and eager to gain hands-on experience with low-code platforms like Appian and UiPath.
Methodical Problem-Solver:

Possess a strong analytical mindset to test beyond happy paths, naturally exploring boundary limits, non-numeric edge cases, and unexpected UI behaviors.
Structured Communicator:

Excellent collaborator able to document findings clearly, articulate technical issues with concrete real-world examples, and contribute to continuous team improvement.
Relevant Academic Background:

Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (preferred but not required).

What’s in it for you
Flexibility to work where you thrive

– Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
Reward for your impact

– Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
Support for your mental wellbeing

– Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
Time to recharge

– On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
Continuous learning and growth

– Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
Exclusive perks and rewards

– Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
Support during life milestones

– Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
Fuel and focus on-site

– Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
Recognition for your contributions

– Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
Show your Bitpanda pride

– Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
Connect and celebrate with your team

– Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.
Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. * These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

Join our Development Center in Bucharest, and become a member of our open-minded, progressive and professional team. In this role you will be working on projects for one our world famous clients.
You will have a chance to grow your technical and soft skills, and build a thorough expertise of the industry of our client.
On top of attractive salary and benefits package, Luxoft will invest into your professional training, and allow you to grow your professional career.

Responsibilities

Backend Automation (High Priority): Design, develop, and maintain robust API test automation frameworks, ensuring comprehensive coverage of data flows and integration points within the Atlas module.
Frontend Automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests for web user interfaces to ensure a seamless and reliable user experience.
Manual Testing: Design and execute manual tests for APIs, integrations, data flows, and web interfaces, including exploratory, functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Test Planning & Documentation: Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and test scripts aligned with requirements, user stories, and technical specifications.
Team Collaboration & Agile Delivery: Collaborate with Product Owners, developers, system architects, and compliance specialists to clarify requirements and regulatory constraints. Participate in Agile ceremonies, provide timely feedback, and promote quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Leverage AI Tools: Use modern AI-assisted coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to accelerate test script development, improve code quality, and streamline the QA pipeline.
Defect Management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution. Analyze results from both manual and automated test execution, support root-cause analysis, retest fixes, and perform targeted regression testing.
Release Readiness & Compliance: Contribute to the SDLC release process by preparing, reviewing, or approving Test Execution Reports (TERs) for production deployments and ensuring test evidence supports applicable AML, GDPR, and local regulatory requirements.
Leadership & Continuous Improvement: Provide technical guidance, promote quality engineering best practices, review and improve test processes and methodologies, and recommend enhancements to manual and automated testing. Keep current with new testing tools, techniques, and technologies to improve quality and delivery efficiency.

Skills

Must have

Professional Experience: 5+ years of hands-on software testing experience, including substantial experience in both manual testing and test automation across backend systems, integrations, web user interfaces, and data-centric applications.
Manual Testing Expertise: Proven ability to analyse requirements, design and execute detailed manual test cases and test scripts, perform exploratory and risk-based testing, validate API responses, integrations, data flows, and web user interfaces, and maintain clear test evidence and traceability.
Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in either Python or Java. As AI-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Copilot are integrated into the daily workflow, logical thinking, clean test design, maintainable code, and architectural best practices are valued over syntax memorization.
Backend & API Testing (High Priority): Proven experience automating REST and/or SOAP API tests with tools such as REST Assured, Requests, PyTest, or Postman. Strong understanding of integration testing, data integrity, source-to-target validation, microservices architecture, and SQL and NoSQL database concepts.
Frontend Testing: Solid experience in web UI test automation using modern frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress, together with a good understanding of the DOM structure, XPath, and CSS selectors.
CI/CD & Version Control: Practical experience with Git and a working understanding of integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions, including analysis of automated test-run results.
Methodologies & Test Engineering: Experience working in Agile environments using Scrum or Kanban, Jira, and Confluence. Strong knowledge of the software development lifecycle, test planning, defect management, test execution reporting, and functional and non-functional testing practices.

Nice to have

Experience in the financial services industry, with knowledge of Wealth Management or other financial products.
Experience in coordinating UAT (User Acceptance Testing) activities.
Openness and willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are
At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.
We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.
We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.
Our Values
If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
Who You Are
You are self-driven and like to work with others to remove roadblocks. You are curious and love to explore and learn new technologies. You have demonstrated the ability to build, deploy, and maintain large-scale, complex applications. You care more about solutions and impacting the customer experience than using a particular tool or framework.
About the role:

You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.
This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.
Responsibilities:

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed.

You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded.

You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs.

While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.

Qualifications
5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments

Technologies Used
Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, C#, Python, VueJS, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog

The base wage range for this position based in Spain is 111,000-143,000 EUR.

Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.  Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.

Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (preferred but not required).
